column6: A URL, tagged release, or demo video is provided (link the CI run when one exists); or the note says plainly that nothing works yet and why. Where a video replaces the live demo (a missed check-in, or a TA who could not meet), it is on media.oregonstate.edu, unlisted, captioned, with one timestamp per student.
column9: Item missing: no evidence and no plain statement of why nothing works yet.

column6: One entry per piece of work the team finished this sprint, as a table row or under its own subheading: what now exists, linked to the pull request, issue, or document where it is written up; its owner; and who reviewed and accepted it. Every entry is work someone else took this sprint: the pull request merged, the issue closed with its outcome, or the document approved. Work still open, work finished in an earlier sprint, and routine upkeep (a formatter run, a lockfile bump, a rename, or a ticket moved on the board) are not entries. Non-code work counts. NDA teams give IDs, verified at the check-in.
column9: Item missing: no entries; an entry has no link or ID, no owner, or no reviewer; an entry is still open, was finished in an earlier sprint, or is routine upkeep; or an entry describes how time was spent ("worked on the API") rather than what now exists.

column6: Every student owns at least one entry or is listed at the end as owning none this sprint. Each student's most consequential entry is marked and carries their human-written sentence on how the team checked it: for code, the test or the run; for research, a decision, or a document, what it was checked against and who confirmed it. A review that took judgment names, in its reviewer note, the change asked for or what was checked, and where an AI reviewer ran, what the student checked that the tool could not; a routine approval needs only the reviewer's name. Graders open one owned entry per student.
column9: Item missing: a student with no entry and not listed as owning none; a student's marked entry with no sentence; a reviewer note that names neither a change nor a check; or the entry a grader opens does not show its owner authored or drove it.

column6: Names the risk ranked first in docs/risks.md (ranked by threat to the Definition of Shipped once it exists; to the next checkpoint milestone in fall), linked at the sprint's last commit, however small it is, and one decision the team needs, linked to the artifact where it is being made, naming who makes it, or says plainly that no decision is needed this sprint. Reports the previous note's decision: what was decided and who chaired it, or that it is still open and why.
column9: Item missing: no linked risk; neither a decision named with who makes it nor a plain statement that none is needed; or no word on the previous note's decision, where it named one.

column6: About five human-written lines on what the team learned this sprint, naming at least one change to the plan it caused, with its link (a re-scoped story, a re-ranked risk, a revised estimate), or saying plainly that the plan holds and why.
column9: Item missing: absent, reused from an earlier note, or a recap of the work with no change named and no reason the plan holds.
